description: This file defines a class SugarWidgetSubPanelActivitiesStatusField that extends SugarWidgetField. The class provides a method displayList which renders the status field for subpanels related to activities in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system, specifically retrieving and returning a value from the layout definition based on language settings.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelActivitiesStatusField
classes.description: Class extending SugarWidgetField to render the status field in subpanel activities, handling language-specific display of status values.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates the display value for the status field in a subpanel list, fetching language-specific labels based on layout definition.
